item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 29/Jan/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an intense northeast monsoon, the weather will be very dry over Guangdong today and tomorrow. It will be cold in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. With the monsoon moderating slightly midweek this week, temperatures will rise gradually and the weather will be cloudier over southern China. A fresh to strong easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week. It will be windier over the region.
